_doc: Allowlist of assets intentionally NOT record-bound. Subtracted from link_validator UNUSED so the remaining UNUSED count is a real signal. Schema: {"<kind>": [exact ids], "<kind>_prefixes": [id prefixes]} where <kind> is icon|vfx|sfx|prop. Append entries when the team confirms an asset is library-only (e.g. UI chrome primitives, scene-driven ambient effects, runtime-selected ambience stems).
